decision_rule: Battery R3/R4/R5 rules (fact-check-v-enclosures-battery-generator-R3-lines.json, -R5-lines-A.json), as applied in R6 and R7-PA/PB: a line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is placed at the wrong site, is misdated (board re-post stamp as a posting date; aggregator or expired copy written as live; a date the row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count of postings, leads with an older fact (opening lines), rests on a premise no row states (incl. a question that presumes welding at a site where no stated row of the plant or company shows welding: Virnig R9-closeout and R7-PB precedent; the hedged 'what ..., if any' form is confirmed), lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged. Bottleneck guesses are corrected only when they state as fact something no row supports or place another site's fact at the plant (ordering and premise not checked on them). Unreachable = a clause rests only on a source that cannot be re-read today (no live page, no archive). TALLO: tallo.com is behind a sign-in wall (403 plain, sign-in page in Chromium, no Wayback snapshot); a Tallo-only date or title is unreachable (R7-PB rule). 'listed <date>' for board dates (HII SuccessFactors, Workday startDate, ADP postDate/PostingDate, Paylocity PublishedDate, ExactHire datePosted, Austal board) and 'first listed <raw PostedDate>' for UKG are allowed (coordinator rule 2026-11-17); 'read <Month> <day>, <year>' is allowed where a cited row's retrieved_date carries it and is neutral for newest-first ordering. Live = in the board's own list today. A '# of Openings: N' field on one requisition, written past tense with the row's read date and unchanged on re-read, is a dated fact of that requisition, not a live count of postings (Colonna's 1472, Rhoads).
